Who We Are
Hi, we're DuckDuckGo, the online protection company and remote-first team of 300+ on a mission to raise the standard of trust online. Founded in 2008 and profitable since 2014, annual revenue now exceeds $100m USD and millions use our browser on on Mac, Windows, iOS, and Android, our search engine, and the DuckDuckGo subscription. We also offer private, useful, and optional AI, including Duck.ai, which lets you chat privately with ChatGPT, Claude, and other AIs, all in one place. Our culture of trust, inclusivity, and empowered project management underpins everything we do, where each team member takes full ownership of their projects, from scoping and execution to postmortem. If you're seeking end-to-end ownership of your work, you've come to the right place!

Your Team and Role
Working on the Data Science Functional Team, you'll drive product and business impact through improving our search engine ranking and results. Recent projects include:
• 
Improving first-phase ranking quality and precision without sacrificing latency
• 
Developing new lexical-matching and document-authority signals
• 
Expanding our search evaluations to measure relevancy readiness and surface ranking blindspots 
• 
Investigating LLMs for feature generation and ranking
 
Our data meets rigorous privacy standards and is necessarily sparse, so you'll need to think creatively to surface actionable insights in an evidence-first culture where quantitative rigor is the baseline, not the exception.

About You
• 
You have 10+ years of experience in Data Science, with 2+ years at Staff, Principal, or Director level, and a track record of leading high-complexity projects from scoping to production with minimal direction.
• 
You are comfortable advising others on complex data science work.
• 
You can develop strategies for ambiguous, complex data science problems and turn them into a series of well-defined projects.
• 
You have hands-on experience deploying ML in production, developing NLP solutions, and in AI-assisted development.
• 
You write production-grade code in Python or a comparable high-level language.
• 
You have advanced SQL and query optimization skills.
• 
You collaborate effectively with product teams and contribute to overall team throughput.
• 
Preferred experience:
• 
Running search-specific projects (ranking, retrieval, or indexing) from scoping to production
• 
Working with large-scale search infrastructure (e.g. Vespa, Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, or Solr)

Compensation
$222,033 USD annually and stock options. Compensation is transparent across the organization, and all team members within the same professional level and global region receive the same compensation.
Eligibility for company-sponsored health benefits is limited to team members based in the United States. This program does not extend to team members located in other countries, such as Canada or the UK.
Our Team Member Support Guide explains how we prioritize your wellbeing including paid parental leave, office setup, and co-working allowances.

Hiring Process
Hiring works best when it's a two-way street. Learn how we help you get to know DuckDuckGo, envision your future role here, and find out more about how we hire.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion
DuckDuckGo provides equal work opportunities to all team members and applicants, and it prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type on the basis of race, color, ethnicity, caste, religion, age, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by our policies or federal, state, or local laws.

We want to ensure that our hiring process is accessible. If you need reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process because of a medical condition or disability, please send an email to 

Please note that:
• 
You’ll be required to attend meetings on camera via video conferencing
• 
Expect to travel at least two times a year: once for our all-hands meetup and again for a team retreat (each around 4-5 days). While extenuating circumstances may impact attendance, everyone is strongly encouraged to attend.
• 
While we offer a flexible work arrangement with no core hours, expect an average full-time commitment of 40 hours per week.
• 
A successful candidate must pass a background check as a condition of joining the team.
• 
By applying for this role, you confirm that all information submitted is accurate and complete. You further acknowledge that providing false or fraudulent information during the application process is cause for denial of an offer, revocation of any existing offer, or other adverse action, up to and including termination after the start of your commencement of work.

Disclosure Statement: Use of AI in Hiring Process
As part of our commitment to enhancing our recruitment process, we utilize artificial intelligence (AI) technology to assist in reviewing and summarizing job applications and test projects, including those tools integrated into our recruitment vendor platforms. We use AI to flag potentially fraudulent applications, analyze and summarize applicants’ experience, interviews, and project performance, and help streamline our selection process.

Key Principles:
• 
Data Privacy: All information provided in your application will be handled in accordance with our Recruiting Privacy Policy. We ensure that your personal information is protected and used solely for recruitment purposes.
• 
Human Oversight and Accountability: The AI technology is designed to support our hiring team by providing insights and summaries of applications and evaluations of test projects against scoring rubrics. All final evaluations and hiring decisions, however, will be made by our hiring team, who will consider the AI's input alongside other factors.
• 
Transparency: We believe in transparency regarding our hiring practices. If you have any questions about how AI is used in our recruitment process, please feel free to reach out to us.

By submitting your application, you acknowledge and consent to the use of AI technology in our review process. If you would like to request an alternative selection process, please contact us as at

Role Title: Investment Funds Attorney
Role Type: Contractor
Location: Remote
We are seeking seasoned Investment Funds Attorneys for a part-time role at the forefront of legal AI. This opportunity is for elite lawyers who want to help shape how advanced AI is trained, evaluated, and applied in real-world legal work, especially those who have deep experience with drafting, reviewing, negotiating, and redlining within the tech field. 
In this role, you will review, assess, and contribute to contract redlining workflows used to train and evaluate state-of-the-art AI models. Your work will directly improve how these systems identify risk and interpret contract language to create tools with improved precision and legal judgment.
Key Responsibilities:

• Perform simulated contract negotiations and redlining exercises. 

• Review and assess AI responses to contract scenarios, providing expert feedback to improve model performance and output precision.

• Create objective evaluation frameworks and grading criteria to assess AI performance on contract tasks with rigor and consistency.

• Collaborate with product and research teams to refine data, guidelines, and best practices for AI-driven contract review solutions.

Required Skills and Qualifications:

• J.D. from an ABA-accredited law school.

• Active bar admission in at least one U.S. jurisdiction.

• Minimum of 2 years in the funds department of a corporate law firm.

• Familiarity with standard M&A agreements, including LPA’s, subscription agreements, and side letters. 

• Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with meticulous attention to detail.

• Strong analytical capabilities and ability to translate legal expertise into actionable feedback for AI systems.

• Demonstrated commitment to innovation at the intersection of law and technology.

• Experience working with cross-disciplinary teams in fast-paced environments.

Preferred Qualifications:
• Prior exposure to AI, legal tech, or training initiatives. 
Why Join: 

• This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of law and technology.

• You will help define how AI is developed for a new generation of legal practitioners.

• You will apply your experience in a high-impact research environment.

Compensation Structure:
• Compensation is task-based, meaning experts are paid per completed task that meets the project specifications. The average handling time (AHT) is approximately 3.5 hours per task, and the effective hourly rate will depend on the number of tasks completed and successfully signed off.

f218c9cd1e96ec38.description: Asia's leading robotics solutions provider, automating enterprise supply chains since 2017. We build syncOS — the industry-first no-code platform that lets manufacturers and warehouse operators integrate, reprogram, and scale automation systems without halting production or calling in specialists. Our autonomous mobile robots (AMRs) run 24/7 for global brands — transforming production lines in hours, not weeks. Our product stack spans AMR hardware and robot software through fleet management and SyncOS — the software layer that orchestrates automation workflows, coordinates fleets and equipment, connects them with enterprise systems, and makes automated operations observable and manageable. As robotic systems scale from individual deployments to complex operations, increasingly difficult product problems move into the software layer: which robot should execute which task, how fleets share constrained infrastructure, how workflows adapt as operating conditions change, and how problems are detected and understood before operations are disrupted. We are building the product team responsible for this layer. As a Senior Product Manager on SyncOS, you will own a significant part of the platform and take hard systems problems from operational need to product model to system behaviour to measurable production outcome. **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:** - Autonomous Fleet Intelligence & Orchestration - Build the intelligence that determines how autonomous fleets operate under real-world constraints. This spans the decisions that determine which robot does what, how shared resources are allocated, how competing priorities are resolved, and how the system adapts as operating conditions change — reducing dependence on operator intervention and site-specific logic - Operational Intelligence & Observability - Turn operational data and deployment learning into intelligence that helps customers understand and improve their automated operations. Build the product capabilities needed to make system health and performance observable, detect developing problems before they disrupt operations, and put failures in context when they occur - Own a meaningful SyncOS problem space and its roadmap, outcomes and product decisions - Start from operational problems rather than feature requests, and define precisely how the system should behave - Use production and deployment evidence to identify where the product needs to become more intelligent, configurable or reusable - Distinguish customer-specific needs from capabilities that should become part of the product - Define measurable product outcomes, system behaviour and acceptance conditions before engineering work begins - Partner deeply with software, robotics, solutions and deployment teams from problem definition through production validation **Requirements** - 5–7 years of product-management experience building technically complex software products. Particularly interested in people who have worked on workflow, orchestration, scheduling, logistics, data-intensive products or developer/platform tools - Worked naturally from operational data: defining events, states and metrics and using production evidence to make product decisions - Shipped systems where software makes operational decisions or helps users understand and act on complex system behaviour - Turned repeated customer-specific work into configurable or reusable product capability - Worked deeply enough with backend/platform engineers to reason about state, contention, dependencies, race conditions and failure modes - Written product specifications precise enough to define rules, edge cases and expected behaviour when multiple constraints conflict **Highly Desireable:** - Experience with multi-agent/fleet coordination, logistics optimisation, workflow/low-code platforms, observability and operational tooling, or WMS/MES/ERP and industrial integrations - Experience in robotics, AMR/AGV, intralogistics, warehouse automation or industrial systems is valuable but not required **Benefits** - Competitive salary - Comprehensive health benefits package - Hustle of a young startup, always something to do and something to improve - Opportunities for professional development and growth into management roles - Collaborative and inclusive work environment

f29b958d7342ccd4.description: Trading Research Intern Manifest Capital About Manifest Capital Manifest Capital is a proprietary, fundamentals-first investment and trading firm focused on opportunities across public and private markets. We look for compelling business and asset narrativesand then meticulously test those narratives against financial performance, industry dynamics and economic reality. We are hiring a Trading Research Intern to work directly with the Founder and support the firms public-markets trading research. The role: The intern will independently analyse companies and sectors, prepare structured research reports and present their findings verbally to the Founder. The objective is not merely to collect information. The candidate must be able to connect macroeconomic, industry and company-level developments, form an informed view on a companys earnings cycle and respond to detailed follow-up questions that support timely trading decisions. Typical responsibilities will include: Tracking relevant macroeconomic, sector and company-specific developments Analysing business models, industry structures and competitive positioning Identifying the factors affecting revenue, costs, margins and earnings Studying demand cycles, consumption behaviour and capital-expenditure trends Reading financial statements, annual reports, investor presentations and management commentary Preparing structured company and sector research reports Presenting conclusions verbally and answering questions on the research Continuously updating the thesis as new information emerges What we are looking for: The candidate should have an understanding of the global macroeconomic setting, including but not limited to: Inflation, interest rates, bond yields and monetary policy Foreign-exchange movements Fiscal policy International trade policy and geopolitical relationships Commodity cycles Economic growth and business cycles across major economies The candidate should also understand the fundamentals of a business, including: Industry structures, competitive dynamics and economic moats Business models and the drivers of company revenue, costs and margins Financial statements and key financial ratios The relationship between macroeconomic developments and company earning Strong written and verbal communication skills are essential. The candidate should be comfortable working with financial data, thinking independently and explaining complex ideas clearly. We are not looking for prior market experience. We want a candidate who intuitively understands a public company as a piece of the puzzle the global economy is, and is truly curious to know how the earnings of the company moves with the world around it. Engagement This is a paid, part-time and remote internship requiring a commitment of approximately four to five hours per day.
